q_001.sql:
SELECT g.Name AS Genre, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalSales
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
LIMIT 5;
q_001.answer:
**Top 5 Best‑Selling Genres (by total sales)**  

| Rank | Genre               | Total Sales (USD) |
|------|---------------------|-------------------|
| 1    | Rock                | **$826.65** |
| 2    | Latin               | **$382.14** |
| 3    | Metal               | **$261.36** |
| 4    | Alternative & Punk | **$241.56** |
| 5    | TV Shows            | **$93.53** |

These figures are calculated by summing `UnitPrice × Quantity` for every invoice line belonging to tracks of each genre.

q_004.sql:
SELECT mt.Name AS MediaType, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount
FROM MediaType mt
JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
ORDER BY TrackCount DESC
LIMIT 1;
q_004.answer: The most popular media type, based on the number of tracks, is **“MPEG audio file”** with **3,034 tracks**.

q_005.sql:
SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount
FROM Employee e
JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId
ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC
LIMIT 1;
q_005.answer: The employee with the most customers assigned is **Jane Peacock** (EmployeeId 3), who has **21 customers**.

q_009.sql:
SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, TotalSpending,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC) AS Rank
FROM (
    SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName,
           COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS TotalSpending
    FROM Customer c
    LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId
) 
ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC
LIMIT 5;
q_009.answer:
**Top 5 Customers by Total Spending**

| Rank | Customer ID | First Name | Last Name | Total Spending (USD) |
|------|-------------|------------|-----------|----------------------|
| 1 | 6 | Helena | Holý | **$49.62** |

These customers are ranked by the total amount they have spent across all invoices, with the highest spenders listed first. Customers 45 and 46 share the same total, resulting in a tie for the 4th place.

q_010.sql:
SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) AS genre_count
FROM Artist ar
JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
WHERE t.GenreId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 3
ORDER BY genre_count DESC, ar.Name;
q_010.answer:
